notes.title: September Update - Combat, Encounters, and More!
notes.content:
[h1][b]September Update - Combat, Encounters, and More![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/caf35f3660d4cef4d05513edf9e80a5f3e8669f6.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hey Disco Crew! [/b][/h1]

After listening closely to all the feedback you’ve been sharing, we’ve made changes to help combat feel smoother, snappier, and more in tune with the beat. Some of them tweaks tackle things that were breaking the flow, while others are more to make sure fights feel fair and fun.

We can’t say this enough: your feedback has been incredibly helpful. Every little comment goes a long way in shaping Dead as Disco, so please keep it coming. Jump into our [url=https:https://discord.gg/deadasdisco]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts and maybe even get the chance to join future exclusive playtests!
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Combat[/b]  [/h1]

[b]Counter whiff animation can now be interrupted[/b]  
No more feeling stuck in place after a missed counter! Previously, Charlie would lock up for a bit too long if you pressed the counter with nothing to block. We know it made fights feel a little clunky, so now you can break out of the whiff animation and get right back into the fight.

[b]Beat sync improvements at low FPS[/b]  
For players running on lower frame rates, the combat/music sync could sometimes feel slightly off. That should now be fixed, so the beat stays locked in no matter what setup you’re on.

[b]Heavy attack input fix[/b]  
We fixed a small input dead zone where holding Heavy Attack could sometimes do… nothing. That’s gone, every press should now feel responsive and reliable.
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Encounters[/b]  [/h1]

[b]Removal of low-health Stan enemies[/b]  
These Stans had less health but didn’t play by the stun rules, which ended up hurting the flow more than helping it. We’ve taken them out for now so fights stay consistent and fun.

[b]Windmill attack sound cues[/b]  
The Windmill attack now comes with a sharper audio cue. Even if you’re not hitting, you’ll still hear the rhythm to help keep you on beat.

[b]Camera adjustments[/b]  
We’ve loosened up a few of the tighter zoom-ins so you’ve got a clearer view of what’s happening around Charlie, without losing that cinematic flair.

[b]Stardoll Sniper damage adjustments[/b]  
No more instant wipeouts from multiple snipers hitting all at once. Now, they’ll only ever stack up to two hits’ worth of damage in a single moment. Plus, their lasers now flash red on the beat before firing, giving you a fair warning to dodge in style.

[b]Fallen Bots with clearer visuals[/b]  
Fallen bots now signal their attacks and explosion sequences much more clearly. Even though Arora’s stage isn’t in the demo, you’ll still see these guys in Infinite Disco, and this should make them a lot easier to read.
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Additional Items[/b]  [/h1]

[b]Chromatic aberration toggle[/b]  
A brand-new video setting! For anyone sensitive to the Chromatic Aberration effect, you can now turn it off completely. Comfort first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/7888e5c8fb0f8ceb6bb0014b6232aa73ffc1dc81.png[/img]

[b]Song of the Day in Infinite Disco[/b]  
Infinite Disco now spotlights a Song of the Day, complete with its own leaderboard. It’s a small taste of what’s to come, we’ll be building on this feature with rewards and other surprises in future playtests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/b15b01d63e0fcd75720a72bfb3e317e53e595231.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for being part of this journey with us, helping us make Dead as Disco the best it can be!  
-The Dead as Disco Team

notes.title: August Update - Gamescom, Demo Updates, Playtest Dates, and More!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Disco Crew,[/p][p]The tour bus is revved up, the setlist’s locked, and August is about to be a showstopper. We’re rolling into Gamescom, cranking out fresh demo updates, and lining up new playtests all while keeping the groove alive with your feedback. So grab your backstage pass and let’s dive into what’s next for Dead as Disco.
[/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcA8XlZUiAbLkytbCnuWX-UhAwuUaun9F4D8hnwFA9K3l5311mTNge_3hsYpwVXht74WfM0fX2c7_xpIAvJxiUA8hOTf8QcyYlMTWOCzT71h0UbFt_oxmVavJpXQXsRy4Q44M9W?key=DOD_zR9z14wkntdsiQIa1A"][/img][/b]
[b]Dead as Disco @ Gamescom![/b][/h1][p]The tour bus is packed and we’re taking this show on the road! Dead as Disco is coming to Gamescom August 20th to 24th! [b]Come see us at the Firstlook Festival booth in the Indie Games area - Hall 10.2.[/b]

This is your opportunity to meet the Developers and get hands on with the latest game update. We’ve even got a special surprise in store for players that challenge Hemlock and emerge victorious!
[/p][p]We can’t wait to see you at the Show!
[/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]July Demo Update Feedback, We Hear You![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]July’s update brought new features, bug fixes and balance changes to the game. The response so far has been fantastic. It’s been exciting to watch what players have created using Arena swapping & playlists, and we’ve received a ton of really great feedback.

Dead as Disco is still very early in development and we’re constantly trying out new things! Our goal is to have buttery smooth music-matched gameplay that works with any song. It should be easy to pick up and play, but also provide depth for combat masters. You'll see us continue to refine and experiment in pursuit of this goal, and we fully expect there to be ups and downs along the way. 

Most importantly we want [b]YOU[/b] to be an active part of this process! Feedback is the lifeblood of any great game, so keep it coming! We’re constantly observing the Steam community posts, Discord discussions, and Demo reviews. We’ve already made some adjustments internally based on your feedback, and we’re excited to hear what you think once we roll out the changes for playtesting![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Playtest update - August and beyond…[/b][/h1][p][b]
[/b]We’re not taking our foot off the gas! After we get back from Gamescom we’ll be dropping a brand new playtest for our Closed Alpha participants! Bug fixes, balance changes, and a new story level to try out.
[/p][p]Not in the Closed Alpha? Fear not! We will continue to update the Demo with balance changes, and infinite disco updates as they are ready. We’re also working on a plan for larger Open Alpha playtests later this year.

In the meantime enjoy this sneak peek, coming soon to a playtest near you! 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcZrLyGYNCEo5mNYRSfZoGMZxpKUOMCl1-_iamtR4xt5V5nsnxP3uHN3eYeKpDZTeavj0y-cHQwN97Mi_BlU2e1mJjVfelyCYgpHYgQmBY-vXOfIUeDO-CInARZ06tWTPF2-CRZRA?key=DOD_zR9z14wkntdsiQIa1A"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]
That’s a wrap for August! We’ll see you on the Gamescom floor and in the thick of the action. Stay sharp, stay stylish, and keep it Dead as Disco. And hey, if you want to swap tips, share feedback, or just hang with the crew, hop into our Discord, we’d love to have you.

-The Dead as Disco Team
[/p]

notes.title: July Update - Playlists and Arena Swaps
notes.content:
[h1][b]July Update - Playlists and Arena Swaps[/b][/h1][p]
After two successful playtests (thank you all!), we’re rolling out a fresh wave of features, fixes, and improvements to the [b]Dead as Disco Demo[/b]! Let’s break it down [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Infinite Disco Feature: Playlists[/b]
Playlists are now supported in [i]Infinite Disco[/i]!
• Create your own set of songs to fight through back-to-back
• Simply select “New Playlist”, name it, and then start adding songs with the plus button next to each song
• Multiple playlists can be created and saved
• Playlists can play in song order, or the “Shuffle” option can be selected to get a different experience each play[/p][p]Please let us know what other features you would like to see for playlists!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/dfa2cd4977994e654d122e6c39c6240bfead68bb.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Infinite Disco Feature: Arena Swapping[/b]
A variety of new Arenas are now available in Infinite Disco for players to experiment with. We can’t wait to see what crazy stuff y’all do with this![/p][p]Arenas:
• Disco Floor (default)
• Bubblepop
• Astral Waters
(each with 2 different color variations)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/f4090b08c623120fc4ee38c5008baea48a966935.png"][/img] [/p][p][b]Choose how you want these arenas to appear during the run:[/b]
• [i]Static[/i] – select a single arena that stays active during your whole song/playlist
• [i]Swap Every[/i] – every 5 or 10 rounds (selectable), the arena will switch to a different random arena
• [i]Swap on Hotkey[/i] – press [b]V[/b] (keyboard) or [b]R3[/b] (controller) to swap to another random arena (future updates will offer more control)
• [i]Swap on Action[/i] – swaps whenever a takedown is performed (more triggers planned in future)[/p][p]🎥 Special note: A [b]Green Screen arena[/b] is available for those who want to make silly videos (only available in Static mode, not part of the random pool)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/750363b6a24a6fa2159f74e8acde0bcc71339d2d.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Combat Changes[/b]
• New Enemy in Infinite Disco: The Fallen bots will start a self-destruct sequence when they become stunned. When they explode, they do small damage and knockback in a small radius around them. NOTE: Effects on the Fallen are still WIP
• Some enemies are no longer automatically put in a stunned state at the end of a non-perfect counter. This was done to make non-perfect counters a bit less rewarding and give some more noticeable differences in enemy types. For those used to the way it functioned in the previous playtest, it may take a minute to get used to. Please check it out and then hit up the feedback form to give us your thoughts!
• The Stardoll Sniper attack timing is now 1, 2, fire (previously was 1, 2, 3, fire)
• The red “dodge” indicator is now over their heads for consistent messaging and to help folks who aren’t as strong at feeling the music’s rhythm
• Standard Security Guards now have a fast counterable attack in addition to their dodgeable attack
• Fixed an issue where Charlie would always get a perfect dodge when mashing dodge during another animation. Charlie now no longer can get perfect dodges from mashed inputs[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]UI Updates[/b]
• Moveset sync counters are now denoted by a yellow star (previously was a green circle and skull icon - which caused confusion with takedowns)
• Offscreen attack indicators now exist to show direction and timing of counterable and dodgeable attacks. There is also the option to turn on indicators for non-attacking enemies. They will show as grey dots. These can be turned toggled in the settings. Attack indicators are on by default, non-attacking enemy indicators are off by default
• A simple health bar now appears over the currently targeted enemy. This is something we are trying out in the playtest and would love your feedback. It makes it a bit easier to know when an enemy will be KOed and helps to avoid unnecessary missed attacks that can end a combo. This can be turned off in the settings
• Targeting indicator is now an X instead of a dot
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/5cddee79f01c860d1ecd7745078abd8184a61272.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]New Songs in Infinite Disco[/b]
• [i]Maniac (Punk Version)[/i] – A punk cover of everyone’s favorite
• [i]Killa Music[/i] – Expanding [i]Dead as Disco[/i]’s rap selection
• [i]Neko Neko Let’s Go[/i] – 194 bpm of pure saccharine[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Other Changes[/b]
• Infinite Disco enemy balance has been tuned therefore the Leaderboards have been reset
• R3 on controller used to be Dance Move. Dance Move is now up on the D-pad for controller
• General visual polish in Hemlock’s level and Infinite Disco
• Fixed an issue where the camera could get stuck sideways when moving it very quickly
• Fixed an issue where strong attack outline and gamepad vibration weren’t getting cleared after Charlie gets knocked out
• Fixed issues where the camera could get under the playable arenas
• Fixed an issue on Stardoll Sniper lasers that made their hittable area appear shorter than it really is
• Many other small improvements and bug fixes![/p][hr][/hr][p]Let us know what you think, especially around playlist features, combat flow, and the new arena swapping options! Your feedback helps shape Dead as Disco. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/deadasdisco"]Discord [/url]to be part of our Community and sign up for our upcoming Playtests! 

Thank you for your support! 
[b]- The Dead as Disco Team[/b] [/p]

notes.title: Join our May 23–27 Playtest - NO NDA!
notes.content:
[h2]Our very first playtest just wrapped… and the response was off the charts.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594537/3f96f1ec932742537eadddd1e7aff60b54ff52fe.png[/img]

[h2]So due to overwhelming demand, we’re bringing it back for an encore performance, [b]this time with NO NDA![/b] 🎉[/h2]

Starting Friday, [b]May 23 at 10 AM PT[/b], we’re opening the doors again and inviting even more of you to jump in.

This time around, you’ll be free to record, stream, and share your experience with the world, no restrictions.

You’ll also get a shot at testing some of our core features, including [b]the music import[/b], letting you bring your own beats into the action. Whether you're tearing it up to Top Charts Hits or dropping your own soundtrack, we can’t wait to see (and hear) what you do.

Spots are limited, and invitations will roll out throughout the week: 

🗓️ May 23 (Friday) at 10:00 AM PT → May 27 (Tuesday) at 10:00 AM PT
👉 [url=https://dead-as-disco.firstlook.gg/signup/playtester ]Sign up[/url] now to lock in your chance
📷 No NDA, post, stream, and share freely 
🎶Test our music import and more! 
💬 Join the [url=https://discord.gg/deadasdisco ]Discord [/url]Community 

We’re thrilled to bring you back into the mix, thank you for being part of the ride.
See you in-game May 23! 🕺
